# Fund to Send Review Mission to Kunasai in March

NEW VELDRANIA — The Fund has confirmed that a review mission led by Anselm Royce will arrive in March to assess Kunasai's repayment plans. A spokesman described the visit as "routine and collegial". In Tarev, meanwhile, Chairman Edin Morav reshuffled his cabinet for the second time in a year as loan talks with Zharan stalled over port concessions. Diplomats in Atiaiaba note that the two stories are, in their way, the same story.
